advice_items.quote: I started at a mom and pop brokerage first one in last one out just hustling man I got rookie of the year
advice_items.summary_en: Be the first one in, last one out, and out-hustle everyone early in your career.
advice_items.summary_zh: 早出晚归拼命工作，初入行就拿新人王

advice_items.quote: I always wanted to learn as much as possible about real estate and then figure out how do I own real estate
advice_items.summary_en: Learn every aspect of your industry—including finance and appraisal—to prepare for ownership.
advice_items.summary_zh: 全面学习行业知识，掌握金融与评估技能

advice_items.quote: all of you guys in this room right now have a lot of ways to help each other out and most people just don't go all in on that
advice_items.summary_en: Go all in on collaborating and building long-term, mutually beneficial relationships with ambitious peers.
advice_items.summary_zh: 深度链接身边志同道合的伙伴并互相成就

advice_items.quote: you've got to be a leader when you know deals are falling apart when you know you got lawsuits... you gotta show up and still lead every day
advice_items.summary_en: Show up every day and lead with composure to support your team even amid failing deals, lawsuits, and personal struggles.
advice_items.summary_zh: 面对危机与诉讼仍要稳住心态带领团队

advice_items.canonical_tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
advice_items.quote: one in 20 Partnerships work out if that... I gave him ten doors and he'd go knock a hundred
advice_items.summary_en: Most business partnerships fail; rigorously test a potential partner's work ethic, sobriety, and discipline before committing.
advice_items.summary_zh: 合伙成功率极低，合作前须先考验执行力

advice_items.quote: we've divided the roles where he's the operations guy... and I'm out there living what I believe is my best role which is networking
advice_items.summary_en: Run the business on clear operating systems and divide roles by strengths—delegating operations and hiring so you focus on vision and relationships.
advice_items.summary_zh: 按优势分工并搭建运营体系，专注擅长领域

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: take off the broker hat we're investors... we have control of this piece of paper which is actual ownership
advice_items.summary_en: Shift from an agent mindset to an investor mindset by controlling property contracts and building equity ownership.
advice_items.summary_zh: 从经纪人思维转向投资者，掌控资产所有权

advice_items.quote: I'm a big believer that you got to have goals in life if you don't have any kind of goal like you can't be happy
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain a clear vision and concrete goals to push toward, as progress toward meaningful goals drives fulfillment and motivation.
advice_items.summary_zh: 人生必须设定清晰目标并持续向前推进

guests.first_money_or_break: 17岁考取房产经纪执照，一边在Papa John's送披萨、拖地打工，一边在小型经纪公司早出晚归；拖地时接到首个客户电话并成功成交，赚取约6000-7000美元，从此踏入房产行业。
guests.role_or_title: Owner & Co-Founder, Taifi Real Estate (Real Estate Brokerage & Investor)
